important_caveat: 100 events measures RUNTIME AND CONFIGURATION REPRODUCIBILITY, NOT precision physics agreement. N=60 (EW) / N=49 (colored) matched events give ~13-14% relative statistical uncertainty on any measured efficiency/cross-section -- these are timing/feasibility numbers, not precision measurements.

item_1_generation_time_per_requested_lhe.note: UPPER BOUND -- includes a one-time Source-directory compile step (only needed once per process directory, not once per point in a multi-point grid). Not separable from a single wall-clock measurement without a second, uncompiled rerun -- not performed, per the explicit stop-after-two-benchmarks instruction.

item_2_shower_matching_time_per_lhe_even.note: This portion IS cleanly separable (explicit 'Pythia8 shower finished after N seconds' log line) and does NOT include any one-time compile cost.

item_4_projected_colored_larger_sample.target: 894 charge-filtered matched events (for N_fiducial~50, per colored_statistics_feasibility_v1.md)
item_4_projected_colored_larger_sample.note: Uses pilot100's REAL measured matching efficiency (0.49), replacing the earlier feasibility doc's less-certain 0.419 assumption. This number is now KNOWN and SMALL (<1h) where it was previously 'UNKNOWN' -- a major resolution of the Phase-6 colored-statistics blocker.

item_5_projected_figure6_generation_only.note: This is the GENERATION stage only (MadGraph->Pythia8 matching), for 13 DISTINCT MASS POINTS -- not 91, because Lambda is confirmed (this project, multiple prior turns) to be a post-generation-only parameter (governs classical trajectory propagation, Eq.3, never a MadGraph input). The same generated 4-momentum sample at a given mass can be reused for propagation at every Lambda value in the grid.

item_6_revised_full_figure6_runtime.downstream_stage_note: UNCHANGED from the Phase-7 estimate (05_coplanarity_analysis/figure6_figure7_blockers_v1/Figure_6_readiness_and_pilot_v1.md) -- this stage genuinely must run once per (mQ,Lambda) COMBINATION (91 total), since Lambda affects the physical trajectory, not just the generation. The generation-stage saving does NOT reduce this stage.
item_6_revised_full_figure6_runtime.conclusion: The previously complete unknown (MadGraph generation time) is now measured and shown to be a SMALL fraction (~3%) of the total projected Figure 6 cost -- the downstream trajectory/detector/reconstruction stage remains completely dominant and is the real blocker, not generation. This does not change the Phase-7 verdict (FIGURE 6 NOT YET COMPLETE -- VERIFIED GRID PLAN READY, not launched), but it does resolve the generation-time unknown that Phase 6/7 both flagged.
